Name: message_type
Description: Exactly one: sales_inquiry, product_question, stock_question, complaint, spam, weekly_summary_request

Name: customer_name
Description: Explicit customer name; empty string if absent

Name: email
Description: Explicit email address; empty string if absent

Name: company
Description: Explicit company name; empty string if absent

Name: budget_total
Description: Explicit total budget; use 0 if absent

Name: budget_per_unit
Description: Explicit or arithmetically derived per-unit budget; use 0 if absent

Name: quantity
Description: Explicit product quantity; use 0 if absent

Name: deadline_text
Description: Deadline exactly as stated; empty string if absent

Name: requirements
Description: Explicit requirements such as finish, use, capacity, or delivery timing

Name: lead_tier
Description: Hot, Warm, Cold only for sales_inquiry; empty string otherwise

Name: classification_reason
Description: One concise sentence based only on the message
